title: melica onoei subsp. scaberrima
intro: Melica onoei subsp. scaberrima, commonly known as the Japanese melick or Japanese wild barley, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, which include its ability to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Melica onoei subsp. scaberrima include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
